system.notes: Holds the target in bands of mystic energy: the Spell Success Test is against the target's Quickness, and the target resists with Quickness against the spell's Force; net successes are the bands' Barrier Rating. To break free, compare Strength to that rating (SR2 p.98); a Strength Test against the Force adds 1 effective Strength per 2 successes, and breaking free costs a Body test against (Strength)L Stun. Grimoire (2nd ed.) p.131.
